name: Dranik’s Scar: West
summary: A fortified Muramite staging ground along the canyon wall, scarred by Discord ruptures and Dragorn sabotage.
description: Scar West is the Muramite Legion’s primary staging ground in Dranik’s Scar. The western canyon wall is reinforced with barricades, supply lines, and forward encampments. Discord ruptures tear through the stone, destabilizing the terrain and spawning arcane anomalies. Dragorn resistance fighters infiltrate the area through narrow cliffside passages, sabotaging Muramite supply routes. The region is a volatile mix of military fortification, unstable terrain, and constant conflict.
